page.overview:
Who is Aegir?

Aegir is a student at the Walrus School on Elbaph.

Aegir is an average-sized giant child with round eyes and nose, a large forehead, and short brown hair which is spiked up. He wears a light long-sleeved shirt, a dark cape, a shoulder belt, a kilt, and boots.

Like other Walrus School students, Aegir is against violence and fighting. He is also afraid of heights. However, he also possesses a lecherous side, as shown when he clung to Gerd's chest while giving Sanji a smug look. After being scared by Luffy, he is shown to be cautious around all members of the Straw Hat Pirates.

When the Straw Hat Pirates visited the Walrus School, Aegir informed Luffy, Zoro, and Usopp that it was no longer allowed to use offensive language or be taught how to fight. Later, he rode on a giant swing with Luffy, Usopp, and Skaldi. However, Luffy wanted to go very high on the swing, which made Aegir and Skaldi afraid and wanting to get off. The two were then comforted by Gerd, with Aegir giving Sanji a smug look as he clung to Gerd's chest.
